summary: Risk appetite looks mixed-to-soft today: Bitcoin is consolidating after a strong August run while Reuters-linked coverage says hawkish Fed concerns are weighing on crypto sentiment. The clearest bullish read in the gathered material is still on select altcoins and AI-linked names, with broader altcoin rotation talk from Michaël van de Poppe, but there is not enough fresh same-day evidence for many of the requested traders and assets.
